ctx.x: But then eventually he did get one, and...

Oh, he did get one. When he got with Goodman, I mean... Well, he had one before that. But when he got with Goodman, that really just let him be free as he wanted to be. Because he had a good instrument, and Goodman was featuring him, letting him play -- and he was playing.
Do you remember him at Minton's?
